name: AI Providers API
description: A lightweight AI provider plugin system: a common interface + settings UI + JS streaming for sending prompts to LLM backends (Claude, Gemini, Ollama).
project_description: Central API for AI integrations without too much load. If all you need is: selecting an AI provider, selecting a model, optionally adding parameters like max input tokens, calling the configured provider plugin's prompt() method and getting output, plus a response-streaming API — this is the right place. It is also a good place to learn AI integrations without overcomplicated code. For now the module contains a provider settings form, one plugin type (AiProvider), one plugin manager, and a JS streaming API so replies can appear word-by-word. Ships Claude, Gemini and Ollama provider plugins. An alternative to the AI module package for developers who prefer simple things. Modules using it: LMS AI (AI integration for Drupal LMS).
